Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished landscape storybook illustration for BlitzWord, an English reading adventure for a child. Create one beautifully composed, fully painted story scene, not a collage, not a UI mockup.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is the identity and outfit reference for Artus, the young knight hero. Image 2 is identity reference for his small pet dragon Pip. Preserve Artus's tousled golden ginger hair, freckles, green eyes, green botanical tunic, worn silver armour and red scarf/cape. Keep him a young boy with child proportions. Preserve Pip's orange-gold scales, cream fluffy chest, amber eyes, small dark-membrane wings and leafy tail tuft. Pip is roughly knee high beside Artus. Draw new natural poses integrated into the environment, not the reference poses pasted on.
Style: richly detailed painterly children's fantasy book, warm golden light, deep woodland greens, tactile moss/stone/wood, gentle expressive faces, luminous atmosphere, premium illustrated storybook. Landscape 3:2 composition. Artus is a prominent full-body foreground figure at least half the image height, with Pip clearly visible nearby. Natural contact shadows, coherent perspective and shared lighting. Edge-to-edge art. No portrait badges, panels, frames, borders, inset cards, pasted cutouts, floating sprites, text, numerals, logos or watermarks. Keep important characters fully inside the image.
SCENE 1 — THE FOX'S CALL. At the entrance to a dark mossy stone tunnel under a woodland hill, Artus kneels and listens attentively to a worried adult red mother fox, who looks up at him. Pip beside his knee tilts his head sympathetically. A ruined round tower with a broken crown is visible far away above the trees, the destination of their rescue. A winding trail connects the wooded landscape. Ferns, roots, small wildflowers, amber leaves and shafts of late-afternoon light frame the tunnel. A closed plain leather travel pack lies near Artus. Tell the emotional moment: the mother is asking them to rescue her cub at the tower. The cub is NOT in this image. Artus's hands are empty; shield may be strapped on his back, sword sheathed. Do not show torches, apples, visible supplies or countable puzzle answers. The tunnel is atmospheric, not frightening. Exactly one boy, one small dragon and one adult fox.
